key.name: refresh-interval
key.description: Seconds between two updates of the indicator and of the process list.

key.name: alert-threshold
key.description: VRAM usage, in percent, above which the label is highlighted.

key.name: max-processes
key.description: Number of processes listed in the menu.

key.name: gpu
key.description: PCI address (drm-pdev) of the monitored GPU. Empty selects the GPU with the most VRAM.

key.name: label-format
key.description: Format of the top bar label: full, compact or percent.
